source: Team Fortress 2 — Mann vs. Machine (Gray Mann's robot uprising)
storyline: Gray Mann, the third Mann brother the world forgot, spent a century in a German garden perfecting machines that speak only in ordnance. When the Administrator's gravel war went quiet, his robots marched from the Mann family mines. Saxton Hale punched the first one. The rest kept coming.

classes.note: The nine mercenaries of RED and BLU — the last line between Teufort and the robot horde.

robots.name: Sentry Buster
robots.note: detonates on the nearest sentry gun

robots.name: Tank
robots.note: carries the bomb to the gate; armor soaks crits

bosses.name: Gray Mann
bosses.note: never fights — the mines never mattered, only the harvest

bosses.name: Merasmus the Magician
bosses.note: appears to mock, not to fight
